environment.description: Same application code deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group (priority 1, action BLOCK) that uses a RegexPatternSet match condition on the query string component. The RegexPatternSet ID references a pattern set containing the regex `(?i)(?:['"\x60]\s*(?:or|and|union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|having|order\s+by|group\s+by|into|from|where|like|between|join))` applied with LOWERCASE text transformation followed by URL_DECODE transformation on the SingleQueryArgument 'dept'. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, a second rule in the WebACL (priority 2) uses a SizeConstraint on the query string with a maximum size of 128 bytes (action: BLOCK). The ALB access logs are shipped to S3 but this is monitoring only.

config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
